statement: Replication is eventual convergence over signed messages; it is not a trusted database-copy channel or a global consensus log.
A destination DWN independently validates replicated messages through normal admission.
Missing dependencies must be distinguishable from permanently invalid messages so replication can repair and retry correctly.
A source progress token is a source-local cursor, not a causal clock or global transaction order.
Sync orchestration must not advance durable progress beyond work whose required admission and dependency processing is settled.
Current Enbox durable replication uses MessagesQuery for durable pull, MessagesSubscribe as a wake/latency layer, and MessagesRead for exact retrieval and dependency/data fetches.
Legacy MessagesSync, StateIndex, and SMT reconciliation are not the current Enbox sync architecture or parity target.
